name: CodeT
one_liner: Samples both candidate programs and synthetic test suites, then runs a RANSAC dual-execution consensus algorithm to select the best program.

loop.proposes: A code language model independently generates N candidate implementation programs and M candidate unit-test assertions from the problem prompt.
loop.judged_by: A sandboxed execution engine runs all N x M program-test pairs to build a bipartite pass/fail consistency matrix.
loop.steers: A RANSAC-style consensus algorithm identifies the bipartite clique maximizing (#passing_programs x #passed_tests) and selects its representative program.

headline_result: Raised pass@1 on HumanEval to 65.8% (+18.8 points over Codex greedy decoding) and improved MBPP and APPS accuracy by over 15 points.
caveat: If the LLM shares a systematic misconception across both its generated implementations and its generated tests, the consensus clique can still favour a flawed behavior.
beyond_harness_note: A deterministic RANSAC bipartite consensus algorithm searches the N x M execution matrix to select the most consistent program cluster.
algorithmic_authority: Sandboxed execution matrix and RANSAC bipartite consensus solver

sources.title: CodeT: Code Generation with Generated Tests (ICLR 2023 / arXiv:2207.10397)

verification.notes: Checked against Chen et al., ICLR 2023.
